findings.body: The new predicate accepts a `failed` record with `errorMessage: "worker uncaughtException: …"` as worker-proved. The pre-existing crash guard writes that record and calls `process.exit(1)` without closing the app-server. If a descendant survives after its intermediate parent exits, the documented 241 orphan scan can return empty; `cancelDecision` then returns `pending:false` despite the unverified tree. An acknowledged interrupt can also cause `commitCancel` to replace the failure with `cancelled`. The predicate and decision result were confirmed with a read-only Node check; the surviving-descendant sequence is an inference from the documented scan limit.
findings.recommendation: Treat an empty 241 result as pending unless a separate marker proves verified tree teardown; crash-guard failures must never set that marker.

# Codex Adversarial Review

Target: branch diff against main
Verdict: needs-attention

DO-NOT-SHIP: wave 12 can report cancellation as confirmed after an unverified worker crash.

Findings:
- [high] 1. BLOCKING: crash-guard failure passes the worker proof check (plugins/codex/scripts/lib/job-control.mjs:330-335)
  The new predicate accepts a `failed` record with `errorMessage: "worker uncaughtException: …"` as worker-proved. The pre-existing crash guard writes that record and calls `process.exit(1)` without closing the app-server. If a descendant survives after its intermediate parent exits, the documented 241 orphan scan can return empty; `cancelDecision` then returns `pending:false` despite the unverified tree. An acknowledged interrupt can also cause `commitCancel` to replace the failure with `cancelled`. The predicate and decision result were confirmed with a read-only Node check; the surviving-descendant sequence is an inference from the documented scan limit.
  Recommendation: Treat an empty 241 result as pending unless a separate marker proves verified tree teardown; crash-guard failures must never set that marker.

Next steps:
- Add a Windows regression with a crash-guard failure and a surviving detached grandchild whose intermediate parent has exited.
